mapper.select: /* springsecurity-mapper.xml selectErpUserView 설계사 정보 조회 */ SELECT TB1.mb_id , TB1.mb_nm , TB1.mb_login_id , TB2.login_id AS user_id , TB2.emp_cd , TB4.emp_nm , TB2.user_pwd AS password , TB3.role_id , CASE WHEN concurrent_idx = 1 THEN TB4.jikgub ELSE TB3.jikgub END AS jikgub , CASE WHEN concurrent_idx = 1 THEN TB4.jikchk ELSE TB3.jikchk END AS jikchk , CASE WHEN concurrent_idx = 1 THEN TB4.scd ELSE TB3.scd END AS scd , CASE WHEN concurrent_idx = 1 THEN TB5.snm ELSE TB6.snm END AS snm , TB4.hpno , TB4.telno , TB4.extno , TB4.email , TB4.empsta , TB4.pay_gbn , TB2.pwd_intzn_type , TB2.acct_lock_type , TB1.pkg_name , TB3.concurrent_idx , TB2.login_autr_type , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS login_time , TB1.logo_url , TB1.copy_right , IFNULL(TB1.session_time, 30) AS session_time , 'CMS4' AS project_type FROM tbsy_member TB1 INNER JOIN tbsy_login TB2 ON TB1.mb_id = TB2.mb_id AND TB2.login_id = #{login_id} INNER JOIN tbsy_user_role_map TB3 ON TB1.mb_id = TB3.mb_id AND TB2.emp_cd = TB3.emp_cd AND TB3.concurrent_idx = #{concurrent_idx} INNER JOIN tbin_empmst TB4 ON TB1.mb_id = TB4.mb_id AND TB2.emp_cd = TB4.emp_cd INNER JOIN tbin_scd TB5 ON TB1.mb_id = TB5.mb_id AND TB4.scd = TB5.scd LEFT JOIN tbin_scd TB6 ON TB1.mb_id = TB6.mb_id AND TB3.scd = TB6.scd WHERE TB1.mb_login_id = UPPER(#{mb_id}) AND TB1.mb_login_id IN ()
